listing.name: Customizable Regalia
listing.summary: Yea, this. Makes Regalia from Tahlan Shipworks behave like Virtuous from Diable Avionics. Safe to add to existing save file, not safe to remove (duh). Enjoy your Accelerated Ammo Feeder mechs with two energy weapons I guess.
listing.aiSummary: Changes Regalia mechs to behave like Virtuous mechs, allowing them to use two energy weapons.

description: Modifies the behavior of Regalia mechs from Tahlan Shipworks to match that of Virtuous mechs from Diable Avionics. This change enables the use of Accelerated Ammo Feeder mechs equipped with two energy weapons.
